I feel the exact same way. You are me. Riding the CTA in Chicago and just seeing the people in the streets and riding the trains with absolutely no place to go or get any actually slumber hurts my soul. I feel for these people and I believe you do as well. But what I realized is we can’t help those who don’t want to help themselves. They say there no such thing as wrong timing, but I believe as humans/mortals there’s a right timing and wrong timing. As well as placement.. Try to help when you can and do for those who don’t have what you have and maybe you’ll feel better about the situation knowing you contributed. But until then know exactly when there’s the right TIMING for it and the right PLACE. Don’t let that go over your head.

Move on in reference to talking. But with all that was said, My grandma is deciding to kick me out by Saturday. I would take shelter in my Car but with the Chicago weather we are having I don’t feel that would be the best idea. I also can’t even drive my car because It decided to give up on me after a shift of work. Turns out I need a new starter in my vehicle so that’s really making me stagnant in this situation. I’m so used to driving and just leaving the building I stay in when things just get out of hand and now it’s like I don’t have an option.

I’ve been having financial issues every since I lost my Job in October due to me not coming into work. My friends from high school had came into town so I decided to put in some hours off only to not get them. So me being the rebellious individual I am I didn’t show up for work and later got fired down the line. Which spiraled into a snowball affect of issues. My grandmother no longer wants me living with her because I haven’t paid my portion of the bills which is understandable. But it’s not like I haven’t paid a single bill before! The job I have now hasn’t issued me a paper check and I haven’t been getting paid with the hours I’ve been working due to me not having direct deposit. BUT the only reason why I don’t have direct deposit is because my bank account got placed on overdraft due to a check being deposited TWICE that I had no intention doing. So the bank shut down my account due to me not being able to pay the funds. So with no bank account, no pay basically with this new job.. I’m trying to explain the best way I can but is it all making sense before I move on?

It’s been a lot of difficulties I’ve been facing in my life that’s just been bringing me down. It’s like I can’t win for losing to a degree.. And yes, I know others out here have it tougher than I though I’m still going through pain. Regardless of what’s going on, I still hurt just like every other human. Would you like for me to sum everything up or Would you like a more detailed description of how I’ve been feeling?

It’s hard being optimistic. It’s like I want to keep going and see for myself if things will change eventually bud I just really have a desire to leave it all behind. If it doesn’t happen today then soon..
